scripts.build:site: npm run build:extension && vite build && cp staticwebapp.config.json dist/site/ && npm run archive:extension && npm run verify:package
scripts.archive:extension: mkdir -p dist/site/downloads && find .output/chrome-mv3 -exec touch -t 200001010000 {} + && cd .output/chrome-mv3 && zip -Xqr ../../dist/site/downloads/listen-back-reader.zip .
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && node scripts/deploy-site.mjs && VERIFY_BASE_URL=https://listen-back-reader.sociobot.in npm run test:deployment
